'''Jason O'Leary''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 8th at [[February 2000 St. Cloud tournament]] on 26 February 2000 with SCrew deck (Cloud City start), according to Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d295">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-01-st-cloud-mn-2-26-00d295/ st-cloud-mn-2-26-00], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 1 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-01-st-cloud-mn-2-26-00d295/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
